steps.content:
It has been more than a hundred days since the <color=#fb9259>reappearance of BR-002</color>. The Rustfire rebellion has died down, and Parma's plans have also been thwarted.

Just as the administrators had expected, the enemy retreated from Eastside. Major Mania incidents drastically reduced in the eastern part of the city, and active conflicts became further concentrated in West District, which minimizes the overall damage dealt to DisCity.

But at the same time, the sheriffs received urgent intelligence that several high Eastside officials have appeared on a <color=#fb9259>hit list</color>. 
This is no doubt the enemy's retaliatory tactic, designed to spread terror and shake the will of the main combatants in West District.

An urgent special escort and investigation mission has been launched to foil the enemy's plan. Their scheme must be nipped in the bud before the effects spread further.

July 19, N.F. 113 - Eastside District 01
Erica Villa - Security Zone

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: Warning! Security line breached! The protection target is under attack! The attacker is nearby!

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: All personnel, blockade the villa! If any other assassins dare to step in there, riddle them with bullets!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: B-but... There were traces of supernatural power at the scene! There are likely Sinners among the assassins!

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: What did you say?!

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: ...These Mania monsters... these... monsters...

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: Call the MBCC!! Aren't they the ones who are supposed to be dealing with the Sinners? Where are they????

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: They won't come. Their <color=#fb9259>Chief</color> is dead, and they've lost control over all their Sinners. We can't count on the MBCC for any help!

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: Then ****** call someone else! The sheriffs, the FAC, the 9th Agency... Call everyone!

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: When are they gonna release the <color=#fb9259>Blue Rain</color>? Monsters are running all over the place already. What is the FAC waiting for?

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: Isn't that woman from Paradeisos?! No matter how low-ranked she is, she can't die in this villa!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Commander! The enemy has disappeared from our radar... I'm afraid...
Shhh... Relax, this won't hurt...

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: A Sinner?!! Ahh...!!

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: Who is it now?!
...Special unit of the FAC Anti-Mania Force, requesting to intervene.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: FAC?

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: Thank goodness, you're finally here! How many of you are there? Hurry up, we can't hold out much longer!
Already at the scene. The number of personnel is...
One.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: What?! One person? Do you have any idea how...
Clank...!!
The woman rams her heavy shields into the ground, frightening the Security Chief into silence. She leans on the shields and stands up slowly.
Tell your men to leave if they don't want to get hurt by friendly fire.
Sinner, <color=#fb9259>Rahu</color>. Here for reinforcement.
Dark clouds gather over the city, and a storm is brewing.
The story that's unfolding is but a joke with several tragic figures as its protagonists.
